snippet.title: Polyzonia - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Polyzonia is an ecosystem sim set in the Amazon rainforest. Start with a barren patch of land, grow plants, create habitats, and introduce animals when the conditions are right. As time moves forward, seedlings become trees, flowers bloom, fruit ripens, and the first signs of a living ecosystem begin to appear.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4651670/Polyzonia/

Developer: Cloudberry Pine
